about: playtest2 2026-11-16, the user's playtest item 3a: 'the Rumble Pak supported notice is cut off at the left'. Cause (playtest2): the lift dropped a parameter -- tools/lift/mips.py counts every `sw $sN, off($sp)` as a register kept for the caller, so a value passed on as a stack parameter looked unread and converted callers left the register out. draw_menu_text_queue (0x80117A84, converted in 0.81) called draw_text_request with three parameters; the request's flags (a3 = lhu -2($s0), 0x80117B74) were whatever a3 held: the notice came out in the big lettering with its lines ending at the picture's middle (QA 2026-11-15_094908 shot 084.6s: x 0..633 of 1280). Until 0.81 (QA 2026-11-13_052103) it was centred, two lines in the narrow lettering. modes_regular_boot's route (power-on to the main menu through the notice). Check: python -I scratchgentsisualfix\qa\qa_checks.py notice <run> (middle within 60 px of 640, nothing cut). LOOK: 'Rumble Pak supported.' / 'Insert a Rumble Pak now.' in the narrow lettering, centred over the logo. 2026-11-07, the two modes phase 1: Regular from power-on -- the original's legal page, logos, intro movie and title (its own PRESS START, no INSERT COIN / CREDITS), nobody touching anything until the title is up; then Start (qa_reg 1: on the title 2 s, as a player's controller 1) -> the Rumble Pak notice -> the game's own main menu; 3 s there, F2 opened on GAME SETTINGS for 5 s (qa_reg 2: the GAME MODE row reads REGULAR; TITANTRON LIVE CAMERA reads OFF -- set off here, so the settings were loaded in Regular), EXIT WITHOUT SAVING; quit 10 s later (qa_reg 8). state.csv (qa_modes): bs_tries bit 0 the running mode (0 Regular), bits 4-7 the migration (0: none, settings_version 5 already), bit 24 F2 open; bs_grabs the driver's step (QR_MAIN 2, QR_F2 3, QR_DONE 13) | the F2 page << 8; bs_step the arcade's menu changes found in the menus' data: bit 15 the data loaded, low byte the championship list's rows (10, the game's own), bits 8-12 BELT tab moved / Survival / Custom Story / GBC as Royal Rumble / Ladder label -- all 0 in Regular
